SELECT 
    pc.`name` AS level1_name,
    SUM(CASE WHEN tds.`stat_date` >= '2026-03-01' AND tds.`stat_date` < '2026-04-01' THEN tds.`gmv` ELSE 0 END) AS gmv_202603,
    SUM(CASE WHEN tds.`stat_date` >= '2025-03-01' AND tds.`stat_date` < '2025-04-01' THEN tds.`gmv` ELSE 0 END) AS gmv_202503
FROM `trd_daily_shop_sales` tds
JOIN `dim_shop` ds ON tds.`shop_id` = ds.`id`
JOIN `dim_region` dr ON ds.`region_id` = dr.`id` AND dr.`big_region` = '华北'
JOIN `prd_category` pc ON ds.`category_id` = pc.`id` AND pc.`level` = 1
GROUP BY pc.`name`;
